name: Bellator Trousers Goldsmith
description:
Stylish, functional, and deadly: the Bellator clothing line is designed to fit in at dinner party just as well as a gunfight. Blending cutting edge technology with precise measurements, these tapered trousers provide some combat protection thanks to the intricate weaving of layered graphene in its threads.

The Goldsmith edition gold filigree and seaming on luxurious black for an extravagant look.
